partner_experiences.experience_name: Daily Walking Tour of Old Tallinn
partner_experiences.description: A daily city walking tour of Old Tallinn, available every day no matter the season or weather. The guide will be waiting with a bright yellow sign.
partner_experiences.meeting_point: Town Hall Square, under the Town Hall clock.
partner_experiences.booking_notes: Minimum booking is 3 hours prior to the start. For the 15:30 tour, please use GetYourGuide or Viator. For last-minute bookings, please use the contact number.

transport_info.general_advice: Tallinn has an efficient public transport system of trams and buses. Use a 'Ühiskaart' (green card) or buy tickets from the driver. Bolt is the most popular ride-sharing app.
